race.comment: FLYWIRE (6) came from nowhere to win impressively on resumption on the Acton track. He's been gelded since that run today and he looks a progressive type on the rise. Can improve again here and he can bring up back-to-back wins. SUPERIOR STYLE (5) was too good from the front here on debut, winning at this track and trip by a nostril. The inside draw should see this set up similarly and with that tactical advantage, that'll go a long way to seeing her repeat the dose. SHOWTIME MAGGIE (7) was solid on the Acton before failing on the heavy deck at Wagga last time. Back onto a firmer surface now is a bonus and it wouldn't surprise to see her improve quickly here. ANTHRACIA (10) can improve now getting out in distance. BOSCO (3) won a trial in good fashion recently and can feature first-up.
